name: dia-text-reveal
blurb: A color gradient band sweeps left to right across text, cycling through it.
description: Renders text with an animated gradient band that sweeps across it. Supports repeating through multiple text strings with configurable timing. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
use_when: Inline text needs a smooth, elegant gradient sweep reveal with optional multi-text cycling.
avoid_when: When the gradient sweep effect is unwanted or text must be immediately fully readable.
a11y: Current text string is fully readable; gradient is visual effect only.
